name: Fibre
line: Quiet wealth in linen and oat: a centred Libre Bodoni headline turns into italic for “and how sure the evidence is”, full-width bands of sunlit reeds and wild barley drift slowly against the scroll, and the two explorers are borderless blocks topped by marble swatches with their network drawings printed on the stone in charcoal.
notes: The texture bands use the kit's data-parallax (0.12) inside overflow-hidden frames with enough bleed that no edge ever shows; they sit still with reduced motion. The networks are flattened to charcoal with an SVG colour matrix and multiplied onto the marble (the second swatch is a warmer crop of the same stone). Sandstone and dunes were tried and dropped: they muddied the drawings. Neither Libre Bodoni nor Figtree has Cyrillic, so the RU site would need other faces.
